name: rendex-mcp
description: Render HTML, Markdown, or URLs to images or PDF, extract clean Markdown/JSON/HTML from any page, compose branded PDF+PNG artifacts with a hosted share link, and monitor pages for visual/text changes. Supports Mustache data templating, batch capture, async webhooks, device presets, geo-targeting, and CSS/JS injection. 13 tools (rendex_screenshot, rendex_extract, rendex_render_link, render_artifact, rendex_account, and 8 Rendex Watch tools). Remote server (mcp.rendex.dev) is fronted by OAuth 2.1 (auth-code + PKCE) with a static Bearer rdx_ fast path; per-caller billing.
